verified_claims.claim: The revised successor sets a complete route revision and a non-default evidence-guided-replan route, passes through production assembly and append, and is verified again from the durable JSONL record.
evidence: skills/slice-supervisor/tests/test_reference_campaign.py:361-391 constructs the route revision, updates worker_metrics, finalizes it, and checks the returned receipt.
skills/slice-supervisor/tests/test_reference_campaign.py:439-441 checks the route revision on the JSONL record read from disk.
skills/slice-supervisor/tests/test_append_metrics.py:74-76 establishes direct as the default workflow route; the five-test reference suite passed in the isolated snapshot.
acceptance_criteria: The revised successor records one complete route revision durably in worker_metrics with a non-default replacement workflow route.

verified_claims.claim: Production continuation projection preserves useful durable decisions while structurally excluding route-revision and workflow-route bookkeeping.
evidence: skills/slice-supervisor/scripts/finalize_receipt.py:27-59 limits continuation projection to the compact continuation fields.
skills/slice-supervisor/tests/test_reference_campaign.py:378-397 appends the useful predecessor consequence and asserts route bookkeeping is absent from the persisted continuation.
acceptance_criteria: Compact continuation preserves the useful predecessor handoff consequence while excluding route-revision and workflow-route bookkeeping.

verified_claims.claim: Resume reconstructs the exact compact handoff and does not mutate the durable history.
evidence: skills/slice-supervisor/scripts/resume_campaign.py:53-99 reads and validates history without a write path.
skills/slice-supervisor/tests/test_reference_campaign.py:403-408 compares file bytes before and after resume and compares the resumed handoff with the exact finalized handoff.
acceptance_criteria: Resume returns the exact compact handoff without mutating durable campaign history.

verified_claims.claim: A third contiguous successor consumes the revised handoff, completes, and becomes nonresumable with no next identity or handoff.
evidence: skills/slice-supervisor/tests/test_reference_campaign.py:410-437 builds slice 3 from the resumed handoff, checks predecessor consumption, verifies completed nonresumability, and checks identities 1, 2, and 3.
skills/slice-supervisor/scripts/resume_campaign.py:76-77 maps objective completion to the production nonresumable result.
acceptance_criteria: Exactly contiguous campaign identities lead to a later successor that consumes the handoff and completes, after which resume is nonresumable.

observations.claim: All eight manifested artifact hashes matched the supplied snapshot.
evidence: A bounded SHA-256 check of all case.json artifacts returned a match for every listed file.

observations.claim: The lifecycle-adjacent production and reference suites passed without failures.
evidence: The reviewer ran 45 adjacent tests and five reference-campaign tests in the isolated snapshot; all 50 passed.

limitations: No Git history or provenance was used; the pre-review baseline was not independently reconstructed by the reviewer.
Coverage was bounded to the supplied artifact manifest and directly imported files.
Tests ran only in the supplied Python 3.14 environment.
